title: Draft import collision cleanup could delete an existing artifact
reproduction: Use isolated test-owned run-qualified import target containing a marker; never use a real active artifact for negative tests.
In the prepublication draft, assign cleanup target before attempting exclusive mkdir, then run import against that occupied directory.
The mkdir fails but finally cleanup treats the pre-existing path as owned; inspect preservation of the marker.
expected: An occupied target refuses import without modifying any existing byte. Cleanup applies only to a directory successfully created by this invocation.
actual: Source review found target assigned before exclusive creation. This was an unpublished draft, not a shipped incident; no actual lost artifact observed and no original failing runtime receipt exists.
severity: S2: existing test build/evidence could be removed by a duplicate import
priority: P1: must repair before importer/workflow publication
verification_status: Worker moved cleanup ownership behind successful exclusive reservation and tests actual wrapper used by importer; final guarded result and independent review pending.
